description: This file defines a template class for grouped GEMM (General Matrix Multiply) operations in a deep learning compiler backend, including code generation templates, class methods for adding choices, and rendering functions for kernel code.

classes.name: CppGroupedGemmTemplate
classes.description: A template class for generating code for a group of GEMM operations with shared configuration, supporting multiple choices and rendering kernel code.

methods.name: get_deduplicated_act
methods.description: Deduplicates activation IR nodes based on their names.

methods.name: add_choices
methods.description: Adds different configuration choices for the grouped GEMM template, including options for transposing weights, biases, and activation mappings.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the kernel code string for the grouped GEMM operation based on the current configuration and optional template buffer.
